topic.title: What architecture is working best here?
topic.forumName: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
topic.content: Hey everyone,Just started looking into this problem. What model architectures are you guys finding the most success with?Are simple baselines doing the trick, or is it worth jumping straight into more advanced models? Would love to know what's working for you so far.Thanks!

comments.content: Not sure of the model architectures yet, but random forest as an algorithm seemed to perform much better for us than others.
